Windows: marker check + empty under one OpenClipboard (no interleaving). macOS: best effort, small but unbounded, non-atomic gap between check and clear (no pasteboard lock API). Linux: unchanged (no marker; wl-copy/xclip). Unreadable marker keeps ownership for retry; duet set/clear serialized.
